TC-10/S21.productIssue: NEW (U13 has no gate). A pre-round note whose structured summary failed never ages out. The physician saw 'Note saved, but the structured summary couldn't be updated' and walked away. At 13 h, and at 100 h (cell added in the re-run), the typed pre-round text is still on the chart, in Hospital and in Nursing Home. This happens whether the first save failed or a re-save failed after an earlier successful one. A text that was processed normally is cleared at 13 h. Cause: the 12 h rule in convex/lib/lifecycle.ts only fires when preRoundEditedAt ≤ notesProcessedAt, and a failed save leaves preRoundEditedAt newer than notesProcessedAt (or notesProcessedAt missing). Breaks UAT 3.6 ('pre-round text … 12 h', both modes) and TC-10's 'including text left by a failed summary'. Part 1 passes: the window comes from HOSPITAL_RETENTION / SNF_RETENTION, which are code constants.
